role: Ascetic sage, wrongly impaled; cursed Dharma to be born as Vidura
look: Lean ascetic, about 50; coiled matted jata in a top knot with loose strands; long beard with grey streaks; bare chest with sacred thread; ochre/saffron wrapped dhoti with front pleats; rudraksha beads; tripundra on forehead.
sourceNotes: Vow of silence, arms raised in austerity (Adi Parva 107). Appearance details beyond that are traditional ascetic iconography, a design choice.
notes: on-stake-silhouette has only 'pole' and 'sage-silhouette' groups (no face). On the cosmic court use about scale 0.42 on the lower steps. Reference for young-mandavya: same brow and eye shape.
